title: Docusaurus blog post front matter
description: The front matter of a Markdown or MDX post under blog/.

title.description: The page title, shown in the heading, the browser tab, and search results.

description.description: One sentence about the page, for search results and link previews.

keywords.description: Keywords for the keywords meta tag.

image.description: The image shown in link previews: a path or URL.

draft.description: true builds the page in development only and leaves it out of the production build.

unlisted.description: true builds the page but leaves it out of the sidebar, lists, sitemap, and search.

hide_table_of_contents.description: true hides the table of contents beside the page.

toc_min_heading_level.description: The smallest heading level in the table of contents, 2 to 6.

toc_max_heading_level.description: The largest heading level in the table of contents, 2 to 6.

date.description: When the page last changed, such as 2026-10-25.

last_update.description: Overrides the last-updated date and author shown on the page.

slug.description: The post's URL path under /blog, instead of the one from its file name.

date.description: The post's date, such as 2026-10-25, when the file name has none.

authors.description: The post's authors: keys in blog/authors.yml, or objects with name, title, url, and image_url.

tags.description: Tags: names, keys in blog/tags.yml, or objects with a label and a permalink.

sidebar_label.description: A shorter title for the blog sidebar.
